author: Diego Sandoval
title: Bobby Witt Jr. diagnosed with grade 1 MCL sprain
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. has been diagnosed with a grade 1 MCL sprain.
impact: Witt was pulled from Thursday's game early with knee discomfort, and it has now been revealed as an MCL sprain. Kansas City manager Matt Quatraro called the diagnosis the "best case scenario," although Witt may still have to be sidelined for a short period.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. leaves Friday's game early
desc: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. left Friday's game against the Cubs following a swing in the sixth inning.
impact: Guerrero seemed to grab at his lower back following a swing that resulted in a flyout. This is something to monitor, as the 27-year-old tweaked his back and was forced to miss two games last weekend against the Yankees. Charles McAdoo has taken over at first base for Guerrero.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Black optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Royals optioned Mason Black to Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Black returns to Triple-A with Seth Lugo activated from the concussion injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Seth Lugo (concussion) activated from IL
desc: The Royals activated Seth Lugo from the injured list.
impact: Lugo will return to the mound on Friday for Kansas City. Mason Black was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Harris II (back) remains out of lineup Friday
desc: Michael Harris II is not in the Braves lineup on Friday against the Brewers.
impact: Harris made an early exit from Tuesday's game. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Maikel Garcia (hand) not in lineup Friday
desc: Maikel Garcia is not in the Royals lineup on Friday against the Cardinals.
impact: Garcia will be out another game for Kansas City. He remains day-to-day.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Erick Fedde to follow opener Friday
desc: Erick Fedde is expected to handle the bulk of the innings on Friday against the Tigers following an opener.
impact: Brandon Eister is slated to start for the White Sox on Friday, but Fedde will look to handle most of the pitching duties. Fedde has a 4.50 ERA and 44 strikeouts in 66 innings pitched this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Brandon Eisert to serve as opener Friday
desc: Brandon Eisert will serve as the opener for the White Sox on Friday against the Tigers.
impact: Eisert will get his fourth start of the season on Friday, with Erick Fedde slated to follow him. Through 16 2/3 innings this season, Eister has a 4.86 ERA and 19 strikeouts.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Yilber Diaz being called up by Diamondbacks
desc: Yilber Diaz is being called up to the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Diaz will be making the jump to the MLB club in a corresponding move to Ryne Nelson hitting the shelf. In 32 innings of relief at the Triple-A level this season, Diaz has a 4.50 ERA and 43 strikeouts.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Ryne Nelson diagnosed with partially torn flexor
desc: Ryne Nelson was diagnosed with a partially torn flexor on Friday.
impact: Nelson will surely be heading to the injured list with this injury, but the exact timetable for return is currently unknown. Yilber Diaz is being called up to the MLB club in a corresponding move. Nelson has a 4.97 ERA and 62 strikeouts in 83 1/3 innings this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Justin Verlander (hamstring) scratched from Sunday, expected to miss weeks
desc: Justin Verlander has been scratched from his scheduled start on Sunday with a hamstring injury and is expected to miss weeks.
impact: Verlander suffered a left hamstring injury after throwing a bullpen on Wednesday, and the Tigers now expect him to be on the shelf for an extended period of time. The 43-year-old was expected to make his return from the 60-day injured list on Sunday, with his lone outing of the season coming on March 30th.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: PJ Poulin gets spot start Friday
desc: PJ Poulin will start Friday's game against the Rays after Cade Cavalli was scratched with an illness.
impact: Poulin is expected to be the opener of a bullpen game for the Nationals on Friday. Poulin has a 3.29 ERA and 18 strikeouts in 27 1/3 innings pitched at the MLB level this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Cade Cavalli (illness) scratched from Friday's start
desc: Cade Cavalli has been scratched from his scheduled start on Friday against the Rays.
impact: Cavalli is dealing with an illness, so PJ Poulin will start in his place on Friday. Poulin is expected to be the opener for a bullpen game for the Nationals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daulton Varsho (wrist) hits off pitching machine Friday
desc: Daulton Varsho hit off the pitching machine on Friday as he continues to progress.
impact: Varsho is eligible to be activated on Saturday. If he continues to feel well, he could return without needing a rehab assignment.
